verdict: Strong 28-day ROAS, but purchases have gone quiet for nine days.
narrative: Your Meta ads returned $3.86 for every $1.00 spent over the last 28 days, driven by a strong sales spike on August 11 that produced $1,661.59 in revenue in a single day. Since then, no purchases have come through in the nine days that followed, and daily spend has dipped roughly 10% — a sign the current creative is losing steam. New video content from the Live-Cooking Shoot is being prioritized to refresh the ad pipeline and restart purchase momentum. Separately, Google Business Profile engagement dropped sharply this past week, including two days of zero actions, so local visibility is being watched closely. Expect updated creative in rotation and a clearer purchase trend to report by next week.
